Spec continuity previous_shot null, carry_over []. The prompt's carry-over is image 1 itself, with the unchanged parts listed ("all twelve March clients on each copy, the one client in each April pocket of the right copy").

Positions are anchored: "flush with the organizer's left felt edge", "the top edge of the APRIL row", "same pocket height, the same slanted front edge and the same stitching, not tall round tubes". "fabric scraps" in the negatives is the spec's own term for the four loud fix scraps (spec must_not 'no scraps on either copy'), and the linen band is named separately as "band", so it is not read as a scrap.

FL-02 (object structure): "Each copy is a single felt wall organizer with one header band along its top, two rows of four shallow slanted-front pockets, and one thick label band at the left end of each row." FL-04 (empty props): the content line is present and negatives are targeted. FL-11 (clones): the repeated clients are the intended 12 and 4 per the spec, and the edit keeps them from image 1. FL-13 (logo): not applicable, no brand mark or corner. FL-05 and FL-10: no frames, banners or screens, and "No other lettering."

notes: No producer reasoning was in the packet. Optional, not required for PASS: the spec must_not items 'no glossy CGI plastic' and 'no speech bubbles' are not repeated in the negatives, but the edit keeps image 1 unchanged and the closing line asks for real clay with fingerprints and tool marks.
